paraphrase: Whatever a God with the classical attributes confirms by a sign is true: for every such God and every proposition p, if that God confirms p, then p. This applies divine veracity (God neither deceives nor is deceived) to confirmation by signs; veracity is not among the encoded classical attributes. It applies, and is distinct from, STMT-GOD-REVEALING-CAN-NEITHER-DECEIVE-NOR-BE-DECEIVED. 'By a sign' is the intended reading of the uninterpreted Confirms, not encoded.
